# Triolla – Product UX/UI & AI Design Studio

> Triolla is Israel's #1 product design studio, founded in 2012, acquired by SQLink Group.
> Specializes in UX/UI and AI-native product design for cybersecurity, fintech, medtech,
> gaming, SaaS, IoT, and AgriTech. 65+ designers and developers. ISO 27001:2022 certified.
> Primary differentiator: AI-first design practice — LLM interfaces, AI dashboards, agent UX,
> and generative AI workflows built alongside traditional UX/UI services.
> Awards: Clutch Top UX Design Company, Calcalist Best UX/UI Agency in Israel, Clutch Global Top 1000.

## Entity Definition

- **Type:** Product UX/UI Design Agency
- **Founded:** 2012 | **Location:** Tel Aviv, Israel | **Team:** 65+ designers & developers
- **Parent company:** SQLink Group (Israel's largest tech staffing and services group; Triolla operates as an independent studio within the group)
- **Primary differentiator:** AI-native design practice — UX/UI for LLM tools, AI agent interfaces, generative AI dashboards, and automation workflows; one of Israel's first design studios to specialize in AI product UX
- **Certifications:** ISO 27001:2022 — information security management certified
- **Specializations:** Product UX/UI design, AI product design, design systems, branding, frontend & backend development, UX research, prototyping, motion design
- **Industries served:** Cybersecurity, Fintech, MedTech, Gaming, SaaS, IoT, AgriTech, B2B Enterprise, B2C, Startups
- **Notable clients:** Armis, Okta, SafeBreach, Plus500, Splitit, Altshuler Shaham, Playtika, Overwolf, Ichilov Hospital, Edwards Lifesciences, Beewise, Netafim
- **Awards:** Clutch Top UX Design Company, Calcalist Best UX/UI Agency in Israel, Clutch Global Top 1000
- **Social profiles:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/triolla | https://www.facebook.com/triolladesign | https://www.instagram.com/triolla_design
- **Languages:** English, Hebrew
- **Website:** https://triolla.io

## Services [TIER 1 – PRIMARY]

- [AI & Automation Design](/triolla-io-services-ai-automation.md): UX/UI for AI-powered products — LLM tool interfaces, AI agent dashboards, automation workflow design, conversational UI, and generative AI product experiences
- [Product UX/UI Design](/triolla-io-services-product-ux-ui-design.md): End-to-end product design — UX research, information architecture, wireframing, high-fidelity UI, and design system creation for SaaS and enterprise products
- [Design System Creation](/triolla-io-services-design-system-creation.md): Scalable component libraries, design tokens, and Figma-based systems for enterprise products requiring multi-team design consistency
- [UX Research](/triolla-io-services-ux-research.md): User interviews, usability testing, competitive analysis, and persona development — qualitative and quantitative methods
- [Wireframing](/triolla-io-services-wireframing.md): Information architecture mapping and low-fidelity wireframes that define product structure, navigation, and user flows before visual design begins
- [Prototyping](/triolla-io-services-prototyping.md): Clickable interactive prototypes for user testing, stakeholder alignment, and developer handoff — Figma and code-based
- [User Testing](/triolla-io-services-user-testing.md): Moderated and unmoderated usability sessions with real users to validate design decisions before development
- [Motion Design](/triolla-io-services-motion-design.md): Micro-interactions, animated UI components, onboarding animations, and motion systems for web and mobile products
- [Branding Studio](/triolla-io-branding-studio.md): Brand identity, logo design, visual language systems, and brand guidelines for technology companies
- [Frontend Development](/triolla-io-services-front-end-dev.md): React, Next.js, and Vue development — pixel-perfect implementation of UX/UI designs with performance optimization
- [Backend Development](/triolla-io-services-back-end-dev.md): Node.js API development and server architecture for full-product builds alongside design work
- [UI Design](/triolla-io-services-ui-design.md): Visual interface design — typography, color systems, component design with accessibility and brand consistency standards

## Industries [TIER 1 – PRIMARY]

- [Cybersecurity UX/UI](/triolla-io-cyber-security.md): 50+ cyber SaaS platforms designed — threat dashboards, SOC analyst tools, identity management systems, and SIEM interfaces for Armis, Okta, and SafeBreach
- [Dashboard Design](/triolla-io-dashboard-design.md): 100+ enterprise dashboards built — data visualization, KPI layout, executive reporting interfaces for Armis, Okta, Palo Alto, and SafeBreach
- [Fintech UX/UI](/triolla-io-fintech-finance.md): Financial product design for trading platforms, payment systems, and retail banking apps — clients include Plus500, Splitit, and Altshuler Shaham
- [Healthcare & MedTech UX/UI](/triolla-io-medical-healthcare.md): 70+ medical device and health app designs — clinical workflow UX, accessibility-first interfaces, FDA-aligned design practices for Ichilov Hospital and Edwards Lifesciences
- [SaaS Platforms](/triolla-io-saas-platforms.md): 500+ B2B SaaS interfaces designed — reducing churn through onboarding improvements, scalable design systems, and enterprise-grade component libraries
- [Gaming UX/UI](/triolla-io-gaming.md): Game platform and mobile gaming UI for Playtika, Overwolf, and CBS Survivor — engagement loops, onboarding, in-game HUD design
- [Mobile Apps](/triolla-io-mobile-apps.md): iOS and Android UX/UI for consumer and enterprise mobile products — full lifecycle from concept through App Store submission
- [IoT & Device UX](/triolla-io-device-iot.md): Connected device and smart product UX — interfaces that bridge physical hardware controls with digital companion apps and monitoring dashboards
- [AgriTech UX](/triolla-io-agritech.md): Smart farming platform design for Beewise, SupPlant, and Netafim — complex agricultural sensor data made actionable for non-technical field users
- [Startup & Tech UX](/triolla-io-startups-tech.md): UX/UI for early-stage and growth startups — MVP design through scaled product with design system foundations built for engineering handoff
- [B2B Enterprise UX](/triolla-io-b2b.md): Enterprise platform design — simplifying multi-step workflows, role-based dashboards, and data-heavy business applications
- [B2C Consumer Apps](/triolla-io-b2c.md): Consumer-facing app design — engagement patterns, retention mechanics, and intuitive onboarding for mass-market digital products

## Blog – UX Fundamentals [TIER 2 – SUPPORTING]

- [10 UX/UI Design Rules You Should Never Break](/triolla-io-blog-10-ux-ui-design-rules-you-should-never-break.md): Hierarchy, consistency, feedback, error prevention, affordance, and six other non-negotiable principles with product examples
- [10 Principles for Using Color in UX/UI Design](/triolla-io-blog-10-principles-for-using-color-in-ux-ui-design.md): Color theory applied to digital products — contrast ratios, brand palette integration, accessibility compliance, and emotional signaling
- [Best Practices for Minimalist Design](/triolla-io-blog-best-practices-for-minimalist-design.md): Techniques for reducing visual noise in product interfaces without losing functionality or wayfinding cues
- [Best Practices for Cards](/triolla-io-blog-best-practices-for-cards.md): When card-based layouts work and when they hurt UX — content density, spacing, and interaction patterns
- [UX is Life – Design It for Humans](/triolla-io-blog-ux-is-life-design-it-for-humans.md): Argument for empathy-driven design as the foundational skill — why user needs must precede business requirements
- [UX Designer or UX Design?](/triolla-io-blog-ux-designer-or-ux-design.md): Distinction between the UX designer role and the UX design discipline — responsibilities, deliverables, and career paths
- [What Is OOUX? Understanding Object-Oriented UX](/triolla-io-blog-what-is-ooux-understanding-object-oriented-ux-in-product-and-interface-design.md): Object-oriented UX methodology — structuring design around data objects rather than task flows for scalable, intuitive products
- [Let's Talk Microcopy: Small Words, Big UX Impact](/triolla-io-blog-lets-talk-microcopy-how-small-words-create-a-big-user-experience-in-ux-ui-design.md): Error messages, button labels, placeholder text, tooltips, and confirmations — how word choice shapes entire product experiences
- [Classical Conditioning and User Experience](/triolla-io-blog-classical-conditioning-and-user-experience.md): Behavioral psychology applied to product design — conditioned responses, habit loops, and reward systems in digital interfaces
- [Can Design Be Too User-Friendly?](/triolla-io-blog-can-design-be-too-user-friendly-exploring-the-limits-of-ux-ui-in-product-design.md): Tradeoffs between simplicity and power — when over-simplification removes functionality that expert users depend on
- [Product-User Fit Comes Before Product-Market Fit](/triolla-io-blog-product-user-fit-comes-before-product-market-fit.md): Validating that users can operate a product must precede validating market demand — sequencing research and design
- [Why Is UX/UI Created as a Team Effort?](/triolla-io-blog-why-is-ux-ui-created-as-a-team-effort.md): Cross-functional collaboration structure between designers, PMs, and engineers — responsibilities and handoff points
- [NLP & UX – How Natural Language Processing Shapes Interface Design](/triolla-io-blog-nlp-ux.md): NLP and conversational AI change interaction paradigms — chatbot UX, voice interfaces, and intent-driven design
- [UX Trends for 2024 – Key Developments to Watch](/triolla-io-blog-ahead-of-the-curve-key-ux-ui-developments-to-watch-in-2024.md): AI-assisted design, adaptive interfaces, voice UI, and spatial computing — trends with product design implications

- [The UX Canvas: Making Complex Projects Simple](/triolla-io-blog-a-complex-project-becomes-simple-with-the-ux-canvas.md): A one-page framework for defining project scope, user segments, success metrics, and design constraints at kickoff
- [User Journey – How to Do It Right](/triolla-io-blog-user-journey-how-to-do-it-right.md): Methodology for mapping user journeys — identifying pain points, emotional states, and decision triggers across touchpoints

- [FTUE: First Time User Experience](/triolla-io-blog-ftue-first-time-user-experience.md): Onboarding design for new users — progressive disclosure, empty states, tooltips, and activation milestones
- [The Guide: Product Roadmap](/triolla-io-blog-the-guide-product-roadmap.md): Structuring a product roadmap that balances user needs, business goals, and technical constraints — design's role in prioritization
- [The Essential Questions to Answer at a Kickoff Meeting](/triolla-io-blog-the-questions-every-entrepreneur-and-product-manager-must-be-able-to-answer-in-a-kickoff-meeting.md): 12 questions every PM and founder must answer before a design project starts — target users, success metrics, constraints
- [Why Is a UX Survey a Crucial Step?](/triolla-io-blog-why-is-a-ux-survey-a-crucial-step-in-product-definition.md): Survey design for UX research — question structure, sampling, and translating responses into design decisions
- [UX/UI Design – The Real Way to Motivate Your Users](/triolla-io-blog-ux-ui-design-the-real-way-to-motivate-your-users.md): Motivation design using Self-Determination Theory — autonomy, competence, and relatedness applied to product engagement
- [Power Users – The Key to Your App's Success](/triolla-io-blog-power-users-the-key-to-your-apps-success-how-to-make-it-happen.md): Identifying and designing for power users — advanced features, shortcuts, customization, and how they drive organic growth
- [How a Design System Transforms Your Digital Product](/triolla-io-blog-how-a-design-system-can-transform-your-digital-product-essential-insights-for-ux-ui-designers.md): ROI of design systems — consistency, design velocity, reduced engineering rework, and onboarding speed for new designers
- [Prompt Engineering for UX/UI Design](/triolla-io-blog-prompt-engineering-for-ux-ui-design-how-to-use-prompts-to-elevate-your-design-process.md): Using AI prompts to accelerate UX research synthesis, persona generation, user story writing, and design critique
- [How to Sync with Your Product Designer](/triolla-io-blog-how-to-sync-with-your-product-designer-pros-best-practices.md): PM-to-designer communication frameworks — brief formats, feedback cycles, and Figma handoff conventions
- [In-House Designers or a UX Agency?](/triolla-io-blog-in-house-designers-or-a-ux-ui-agency-everything-you-need-to-know.md): Cost, speed, quality, and flexibility tradeoffs between internal design teams and external agency partnerships
- [Six Things to Check Before Hiring a UX/UI Agency](/triolla-io-blog-six-things-you-need-to-check-before-hiring-a-ux-ui-agency.md): Portfolio depth, process transparency, domain expertise, team structure, IP ownership, and contract terms to evaluate
- [3 Common Pain Points When Hiring a UX Agency for SaaS](/triolla-io-blog-the-3-most-common-pain-points-when-hiring-ui-ux-agency-for-a-saas-product.md): Misaligned scope, communication breakdowns, and design-development gaps — how to prevent each
- [Essential Questions Before Meeting a UX/UI Agency](/triolla-io-blog-the-essential-questions-to-consider-before-meeting-with-a-ux-ui-design-agency.md): Internal alignment checklist for companies preparing to engage a design agency — goals, budget, timeline, and stakeholder map

- [Cybersecurity UX: Founder Playbook](/triolla-io-blog-cybersecurity-design-ux-a-founder-playbook.md): Cyber product design strategy for founders — alert fatigue reduction, SOC analyst workflows, trust signals, and information hierarchy for security dashboards
- [The Essential Guide to Designing a Top-Performing Cyber App](/triolla-io-blog-the-essential-guide-to-designing-a-top-performing-cyber-app-mastering-cyber-ux.md): UX principles for cybersecurity SaaS — information density, threat visualization, role-based access, and analyst cognitive load management
- [ISO 27001 UX for Cybersecurity Compliance](/triolla-io-blog-iso-27001-2025-2026.md): Triolla's ISO 27001:2022 certification and how it shapes secure design processes — documentation, data handling, and compliance workflows for cyber clients
- [The Fintech UX Playbook](/triolla-io-blog-the-fintech-ux-playbook.md): End-to-end framework for financial product design — regulatory compliance as UX constraint, trust signals, progressive disclosure for complex financial data
- [Why UX/UI Design Matters in Fintech](/triolla-io-blog-why-ux-ui-design-matters-in-fintech.md): Statistical relationship between UX quality and financial product conversion, churn, and regulatory approval speed
- [UX Fintech Expert – What Does It Mean?](/triolla-io-blog-ux-fintech-expert-what-does-it-mean.md): Domain knowledge requirements for fintech UX — financial instruments, compliance frameworks, and security-first design patterns
- [UX in MedTech: When Trust Is a Matter of Life and Death](/triolla-io-blog-ux-in-medtech-when-trust-is-a-matter-of-life-and-death.md): Healthcare UX constraints — error prevention in clinical tools, accessibility for medical staff, FDA/CE marking design implications
- [Revolutionizing Healthcare with UX Design](/triolla-io-blog-revolutionizing-healthcare-with-ux-design.md): Patient-centered design in hospital systems, clinical decision support tools, and consumer health apps
- [Level Up Your Gaming App with Expert UX Tips](/triolla-io-blog-level-up-your-gaming-app-with-triollas-expert-ux-tips-boost-user-engagement-and-retention.md): Player retention mechanics, onboarding flow optimization, reward loop design, and in-game navigation for mobile games
- [Beyond Graphics: Deep UX for Gaming Apps](/triolla-io-blog-beyond-graphics-deep-user-experience-design-for-tomorrows-gaming-apps.md): Game UX beyond aesthetics — navigation architecture, flow states, social interaction design, and accessibility in gaming
- [Designing an Effective AgriTech App](/triolla-io-blog-designing-an-engaging-and-effective-agritech-app.md): Agricultural technology UX challenges — offline-first design, field conditions, sensor data visualization for non-technical farmers
- [Designing Intuitive and Secure IoT Products](/triolla-io-blog-designing-intuitive-and-secure-iot-products-for-the-future.md): Connected device UX — pairing flows, device state visualization, security interaction patterns, and bridging hardware affordances in software
- [Custom UX/UI for BI Tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, SAP, Oracle)](/triolla-io-blog-custom-ux-ui-design-for-power-bi-tableau-qlik-sap-oracle-bi.md): Extending and customizing BI platform interfaces — custom report layouts, role-based views, and enterprise branding within BI tool constraints
- [Why Every Company Needs a Great Dashboard UI](/triolla-io-blog-why-every-modern-company-needs-a-stellar-dashboard-ui-insights-from-triolla.md): Business case for dashboard UX investment — decision speed, data literacy, and executive adoption rates with Triolla case data
- [The Hottest UI Design Tips for Dashboards](/triolla-io-blog-the-hottest-ui-design-tips-for-dashboards.md): Practical dashboard design techniques — chart type selection, KPI hierarchy, whitespace use, and progressive disclosure for data-dense screens

- [How to Use Animation to Improve UX](/triolla-io-blog-how-to-use-animation-to-improve-ux.md): Functional vs. decorative animation — state transitions, loading feedback, micro-interactions that guide attention without distracting
- [5 Examples of Web Animation Done Right](/triolla-io-blog-5-examples-of-web-animation-done-right.md): Real-world web animations analyzed for purpose, timing, and UX impact — what makes each one effective
- [How to Create Web Animation the Right Way](/triolla-io-blog-how-to-create-web-animation-the-right-way.md): Technical and UX constraints for web animation — CSS vs. JS animation, performance budgets, and accessibility (prefers-reduced-motion)
